description: This Java class 'FlexibleLocation' provides methods to resolve location strings into URL objects, supporting various location types like http, https, ftp, jar, file, classpath, and custom types via properties. It manages location resolvers and includes utility methods for parsing location strings.

classes.name: FlexibleLocation
classes.description: A utility class for resolving location strings into URLs with support for custom resolvers and various location schemes.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a location string into a URL, optionally using a specified ClassLoader.

methods.name: getLocationType
methods.description: Extracts the location type descriptor from a location string, defaulting to 'classpath' if none found.

methods.name: stripLocationType
methods.description: Removes the location type prefix and leading slashes from a location string.
